## Checklist

- [ ] One focused change, small and independent
- [ ] `dotnet build` is clean (warnings are errors)
- [ ] `dotnet test` passes and new behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` passes
- [ ] Public API has XML doc comments
- [ ] If a recorded decision changed, `NeoReports-Decisoes.md` is updated in this PR
- [ ] Change stays within the v1 scope (or links an approved decision)
